title: The Return of the Beverly Hillbillies
overview: Jed Clamplett and his backwoods family help solve an energy crisis in their own rustic ways for their Beverly Hills neighborhood they still cannot adjust to.

title: The Legend Of The Beverly Hillbillies
overview:
Ebsen, Douglas, and Baer reunite onscreen for the only time in the CBS-TV retrospective television special, The Legend of the Beverly Hillbillies which ranked as the fourth most watched television program of the week—a major surprise given the mediocre rating for the 1981 TV-movie. It was a rare tribute from the “Tiffany network,” which owed much of its success in the 1960s to the series, but has often seemed embarrassed by it in hindsight, often down-playing the show in retrospective television specials on the network’s history and rarely inviting cast members to participate in such all-star broadcasts.
The Legend of The Beverly Hillbillies special ignored several plot twists of the TV movie, notably Jethro was now not a film director but a leading Los Angeles physician. Critter-loving Elly May was still in California with her animals, but Jed was back home in the Hills, having lost his fortune, stolen by the now-imprisoned banker Drysdale. Nancy Kulp had died in 1991 and was little referred to beyond the multitude of film clips that dotted the special.

title: The Clampetts Strike Oil

title: Jed Rescues Pearl

title: Back to Californy

title: Jed's Dilemma

title: Jed Throws a Wingding

title: Jed Plays Solomon

title: Duke Steals a Wife
overview: Duke, Jed’s bloodhound, becomes matchmaker for his master and Mademoiselle Denise, a glamorous Frenchwoman who is accompanying a French poodle intended for the Drysdale’s dog.

title: Jed Buys the Freeway

title: Jed Becomes a Banker
overview: Jed is made a bank vice president so he can compete in an interbank skeet shoot.

title: The Family Tree
overview: An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed’s ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.

title: Jed Cuts the Family Tree
overview: Pearl wants the family to be in High Society now that their forebears were one of the first families to come to America. Will Jed’s family become famous worldwide?

title: Jed Pays His Income Tax
overview: When an IRS agent gets chased away by Granny, Mr. Drysdale tell him the story of how the Clampetts came to be rich and move to Beverly Hills.

title: The Clampetts in Court
overview: A couple who ran into the Clampetts’ car fake injuries and sue the Clampetts to try to get rich.

overview: Jethro tries to help out his restaurant by using Elly as a “topless” waitress (no hats allowed).

title: The Great Snow
overview: Granny is homesick for snow back in Bugtussle, but Mr Drysdale tries to trick them into staying home.

title: The Rass'lin' Clampetts
overview: Granny and Mrs. Drysdale have a scrap and Jed’s ashamed of Granny for fightin’ with the neighbour. Jethro says that in Beverly Hills everyone rassles, he’s seen it on TV. The Clampetts gather around the TV to watch the Boston strong girl battle it out with sweet lil ol’ Rebecca who only rassles to earn money so her parents won’t be evicted from their farm. Granny wants Jethro to take her to the wrestling centre. They’re standing at ringside when the Boston strong girl is beatin’ up on sweet lil Rebecca. Granny can’t take it any more and climbs in to the ring and beats up the Boston strong girl.

title: The Great Tag-Team Match
overview: Rebecca and her Manager come to the Clampetts’ place. The Manager wants a rematch between Granny and the Boston strong girl. Granny says no. Jed offers to pay Rebecca’s parents mortgage and writes them a cheque. Rebecca and Manager want to cash cheque but instead bring Rebecca’s parents to meet the Clampetts. Rebecca’s Manager convinces Granny to fight with the Boston strong girls parents in a tag team match and Granny beats them all single handed.

title: Jethro Proposes
overview: Granny wants Jed to propose marriage to Miss Jane. He says no, so she asks Jethro. Jethro is going to ask but meets Ilsa on the way and forgets all about it. Granny tells him to invite Miss Jane to dinner at a fancy restaurant where he can ask her then. Granny and Elly sit at the next booth where they can hear what’s happening and coach Jethro when needed. Jethro asks, Miss Jane accepts and Jethro runs. Later Miss Jane reluctantly turns down his proposal.

title: The Clampetts Fiddle Around
overview: Miss Jane and Jethro attend a violin recital and Miss Jane suggests Jethro takes violin lessons.

title: The Soap Opera
overview: Granny thinks her favourite TV soap opera is real. She invites the star to the Mansion because on the show he was sick and she wanted to Doctor him. When she thinks she’s cured him off he goes back to work. Next day Granny sees him sick on TV again, so this time asks Jethro to take her to the TV studio because something there must be making him sick. When they arrive He’s in the operating theatre and Granny takes him home so he’ll get better under her care.

title: Dog Days
overview: Granny becomes enraged when Elly May's herd of canine friends trample her every time she announces a meal is ready. Granny threatens to leave unless Elly gets rid of her menagerie.

title: The Crystal Gazers
overview: Supernatural shenanigans spook the Clampetts. Granny convinces herself that she has the gift of prophecy and starts making doubtful predictions for her family and friends.

title: From Rags to Riches
overview: Mr. Drysdale wants to make a commercial starring the Clampetts as lazy hillbillies wasting their lives at the beginning, to successful contributors to society at the end. He dresses as SuperBanker and they recite to the camera how worthless their existence was before SuperBanker changed things for them.

title: Cousin Roy
overview: Cousin Roy arrives and wants to open a Hollywood branch of Mother Mabel’s elixir. Granny doesn’t want her old rival Mabel to be sucessful at her expense, so Granny and Jethro set up a stall on the sidewalk to sell Granny’s elixir. That is until a cop arrests them for operating a stall without a permit. Mr. Drysdale flys Mother Myrtle out to Beverly Hills and just as Jethro and Granny arrive home, she sees Myrtle and runs into the house for her gun.

title: A Bundle for Britain
overview: When Jethro leads Jed to believe that Queen Elizabeth is having money trouble, Jed wants to donate a huge sum to help her out, much to the horror of Mr. Drysdale.

title: Something for the Queen
overview: The Clampetts are flying to London to give the Queen the deed to Canada.  When they arrive at the castle, Colonel Dumbarton next door fires off his sunset canon and lowers the Union Jack flag. Granny thinks he’s startin’ the war of the roses all over again.

title: War of the Roses
overview: When Jethro challenges the neighbors to the war of the roses, Colonel Dumbarton accepts and they commence to joust. Jed wants to go to see the Queen and give her the deed to Canada.

title: Coming Through the Rye
overview: Jethro spies Col. Dumbarton’s niece through his telescope, but Jed mistakes her brother in a kilt for the niece and elists Granny to help break up a potential marriage.

title: Ghost of Clampett Castle
overview: After Mr. Drysdale learns about the Ghost of Clampett Castle, he tries to use the information to scare the Clampetts into going home. However, Jethro wants to hold a seance.

title: Granny Goes to Hooterville
overview: Granny plans a trip to Hooterville but gets side-tracked when she thinks that Jed is planning to marry Miss Hathaway.  Petticoat Junction citizens take Granny’s potent potions.

title: The Italian Cook
overview: Still in Hooterville, Granny mistakes Steve & Betty Jo’s dog for their baby and tries to use tonic to effect some change. Jethro wires Granny to tell her that they are starving in her absence while also hiring a beautiful Italian girl to do the cooking.

title: The Great Cook-Off
overview: Jethro begins dressing and acting like the noblest Roman of them all to win the hand of Maria, the beautiful Italian cook who stirs up a storm.

title: Bonnie, Flatt, and Scruggs
overview: The hillbillies get to play the part of gangsters when Mr Drysdale makes a commercial for his bank.  Musicians Lester Flatt and Earl Scruggs play themselves in a spoof of Bonnie and Clyde.

title: The Thanksgiving Spirit
overview: Thanksgiving with the folks from Petticoat Junction and Green Acres.

title: The Courtship of Homer Noodleman
overview: Drysdale casts Dash Riprock in a new role, that of Elly May’s lover, farm boy Homer Noodleman.

title: The Hot-Rod Truck
overview: Jethro wants to junk his “old wreck” and Granny thinks he means her.  Jethro tells Jed and Granny that they're no longer "with it" and trades the old family car for a new and powerful hot rod.

title: The Week Before Christmas
overview: The hustle and bustle increases as Christmas nears. The hillbillies head for a Christmas in Hooterville and a possible wedding for Granny and Sam Drucker.

title: Christmas in Hooterville
overview: The hillbillies celebrate the Christmas holidays in Hooterville, where Eb courts Elly May and Granny pursues Sam Drucker.

title: Drysdale and Friend
overview: Banker Drysdale is jailed for transporting Granny's white lightning and Elly May's drunken bear in Jethro's truck.

title: Problem Bear
overview: Drysdale has the flu, and too many well-meaning visitors.

title: Jethro the Flesh Peddler
overview: Jethro starts his own Hollywood talent agency on the entire 5th floor of The Commerce Bank of Beverly Hills. Cousin Roy pays a visit when a record agent heard him play back in his hometown, and the gang wants Jethro to take Roy on as a client.

title: Cousin Roy in Movieland
overview:
Roy is still hoping to make it in show biz so Jed decides to back him.
Jethro faces eviction from his office at the Commerce Bank.

title: Jed Clampett Enterprises
overview: Drysdale evicts Jethro from the bank building.

title: The Phantom Fifth Floor
overview: Chaos is rampant at Clampett Enterprises. A building inspector probes the strangely assorted Jed Clampett enterprises on the fifth floor of Drysdale's bank building.

title: The Hired Gun
overview: Drysdale hires troubleshooter Homer Bedloe to evict the Clampetts from his building's fifth floor.

title: The Happy Bank
overview: Business is booming – if confusing – at Clampett Enterprises.  A beautiful secretary at Drysdale's bank breaks the heel of her shoe and hobbles to 'cobbler' Jed Clampett for help.

title: Sam Drucker's Visit
overview: Sam Drucker of Petticoat Junction wins a trip to Hollywood, and Granny assumes that he's come to marry her. He foments family unrest when he visits the Hillbillies.

title: The Guru
overview: The mansion becomes a mecca for a phony guru.

title: The Jogging Clampetts
overview: When the Clampetts take up jogging as a hobby, Mr Drysdale puts on a jogging suit to trot along and seek new business for his bank.

title: Collard Greens an' Fatback
overview: The Drysdales sell their mansion to singer Pat Boone, who is intrigued by Granny's steaming backyard kettle of hillbilly stew.

title: Back to the Hills
overview: The Clampetts head for the hills to snare a man for Elly May, much to the dismay of banker Drysdale.

title: The Hills of Home
overview: Partly filmed in the Ozarks: the Clampetts’ hectic homecoming. The Clampetts arrive in the mountain town of Silver Dollar City, where Granny starts a feud with an old rival, Elverna Bradshaw.

title: Silver Dollar City Fair
overview: Granny is trying to snare a spouse for Elly May, extolling the young girl's virtues to every bachelor she meets.

title: Jane Finds Elly a Man
overview: Jane and Jethro become involved in the search for Elly’s groom-to-be.

title: Wedding Plans
overview: The Clampetts plan Elly’s wedding to Matthew Templeton, unaware that banker Drysdale wants it stopped.

title: Jed Buys Central Park
overview: Con man Shifty Shafer meets Jed in the Ozarks.

title: The Clampetts in New York
overview: Phil Silvers as con man Shifty Shafer. Partly filmed in New York.

title: Manhattan Hillbillies
overview: Drysdale and Jane arrive in New York to try to persuade the hillbillies to abandon their half-built cabin in Central Park and return home. Sammy Davis Jr. has a cameo on the Hillbillies’ New York jaunt.

title: Home Again
overview: Granny complicates things for Elly and her beau.

title: Shorty Kellems Moves West
overview: Shorty Kellems, proprietor of the hotel in Silver Dollar, sells out and leaves the hills to join the Clampetts in California for a fling at the wild life.

title: Midnight Shorty
overview: A rumor that Shorty is a millionaire lands him loads of dates.

title: Shorty Go Home
overview: Granny uses her shotgun as she punishes Jethro for leading too wild a Hollywood life with Shorty Kellems. Granny wants to send Shorty packing.

title: The Hero
overview: Soupy Sales plays the Drysdales’ air-ace nephew.

title: Our Hero the Banker
overview: Mrs Drysdale's nephew, Air Force ace Jetstream Bradford, who possesses a wealth of confidence but no talent, takes over Drysdale's private office at his Beverly Hills Bank.

title: Buzz Bodine, Boy General
overview: Jethro arrives in Hooterville wearing the uniform of a general. Jed arranges to go into the airline business with pilot Steve Elliott.

title: The Clampett-Hewes Empire
overview: Rumor has it that the Clampetts plan to merge their interests with a tycoon. Banker Drysdale eagerly prepares to set up the deal for a new airline formed by Jed and farmer Howard Hewes, thinking him the famous millionaire Howard Hughes.

title: What Happened to Shorty?
overview: Silver Dollar City’s mayor is fixin’ to send Shorty back to the hills. Jed Clampett and Shad Heller conspire to line up Shorty Kellems as a husband for the strong-minded widow Elverna Bradshaw.

title: Marry Me, Shorty
overview: The marriage battle between Shorty and Elverna rages on.

title: Shorty Spits the Hook
overview: Elusive Shorty Kellems gets off the marital hook with Elverna by convincing his eager bride-to-be that he is an inveterate gambler.

title: Three-Day Reprieve
overview: Jed and Shad Heller discover it's a full-time job keeping Shorty Kellems corralled until his marriage to the indomitable Elverna.

title: The Wedding
overview: How to calm a nervous groom: lock him in a bear cage.

title: Annul That Marriage
overview: Shorty and Elverna engage in marital mayhem. The Clampetts set up a miniature farm so Shorty's bride Gloria can sample farm life, and soon the exhausted girl is delighted to hear she's not really married.

title: Hotel for Women
overview: The hillbillies leave Shorty Kellems temporarily in charge of the Clampett mansion and he turns it into a hotel for single secretaries.

title: Simon Legree Drysdale
overview: Slave driver Drysdale meets his secretary’s burly brother. The Clampett mansion is set up as a hotel for women, and banker Drysdale decides to extort a few dollars from his secretary guests.

title: Honest John Returns
overview: Con man Shifty Shafer hooks Jed on a plan to rid Los Angeles of smog.

title: Honesty is the Best Policy
overview: Shifty Shafer and his wife scheme to defraud the Clampetts. Jed prepares to underwrite con man Honest John's scheme to drill a channel in the mountains to draw off the smog in Los Angeles.

title: The Pollution Solution
overview: Jed plans to hand his millions over to the President to help fight air pollution.

title: The Clampetts in Washington
overview: The Clampetts arrive in Washington, DC to give the President $95 million to help in the fight against smog.  A con man tries to sell Washington, D.C., to Jed.

title: Jed Buys the Capitol
overview: Shifty Shafer cons Jed into buying the U.S. Capitol, the Pentagon, and various other choice pieces of Washington real estate.

title: Mark Templeton Arrives
overview: Romance enters Elly May's life in a big way when Navy Lt Mark Templeton arrives at the Clampett mansion to pay a visit. One Granny plus one Navy frogman equals a running gag: Granny thinks Elly’s new beau is a frog.

title: Don't Marry a Frogman
overview: Granny’s trying to cure her frog fixation with a potent elixir.

title: Doctor, Cure My Frog
overview: Granny believes that Elly’s beau is a web-footed freak. Granny consults a psychiatrist to give 'modern medicine' a chance to keep frogman Mark Templeton from turning into a real frog.

title: Do You, Elly, Take This Frog?
overview: A dream sends Granny to a psychiatrist.

title: The Frog Family
overview: Granny battles to keep her family out of the swimming pool, convinced that if they get wet they'll turn into frogs.

title: Farm in the Ocean
overview: Drysdale tries to stop Elly’s marriage.

title: Shorty to the Rescue
overview: Granny’s frog fears prod her to invite Shorty Kellems back from the hills to help break up Elly May’s romance with Mark Templeton.

title: Welcome to the Family
overview: Can Elly find happiness married to a frog? Granny’s still fighting the match. Granny thinks Shorty Kellems has turned into a seal because he ignored her warnings about swimming in the Clampett pool.

title: The Great Revelation
overview: Can Granny finally be convinced that Elly May's boyfriend, Mark Templeton, is fully human and not half-frog?

title: The Grunion Invasion
overview: The Clampetts go to war against a school of fish which they believe to be hostile aliens.

title: The Girls from Grun
overview: The hillbillies, encouraged by Mr Drysdale, continue to guard the Malibu beach and repel the mythical grunion invaders.

title: The Grun Incident
overview: Women’s lib protests hit Drysdale’s bank when his downtrodden secretaries organize to fight for better wages and working conditions.

title: Women's Lib
overview: Granny and Elly launch a fem lib protest. They join the Women's Liberation Movement and leave all the household chores to Jed and Jethro.

title: The Teahouse of Jed Clampett
overview: How to thwart a women’s lib strike: hire geisha girls.

title: The Palace of Clampett San
overview: Granny and Elly seek happiness as liberated women.

title: Lib and Let Lib
overview: The women’s movement strikes at the bank. The hillbilly women, assured of their equal rights, return to the Clampett mansion.

title: Elly, the Working Girl
overview: Elly joins the women’s lib battle against Drysdale. She gets a job at Mr Drysdale's bank and moves into co-worker Jane Hathaway's apartment.

title: Elly, the Secretary
overview: Jethro’s bachelorhood seems headed for extinction. He leaves home when he learns his ugly childhood sweetheart is coming for a visit, not knowing she has become a beauty contest winner.

title: Love Finds Jane Hathaway
overview: An unemployed actor is making a big play for Jane.

title: The Clampetts Meet Robert Audubon Getty Crockett
overview: An actor plans to capture the Clampett millions by passing himself off as kin to Davy Crockett.

title: Jethro Returns
overview: Jane Hathaway learns her new boyfriend is a fortune hunter who would like to marry Elly May and her family's millions.
